description: The signed-in account: status, the plan and its limits (everything is free during the beta), keys and key revocation, and deletion.

action.description: What to do: `status` (default: who is signed in, the free plan and its limits, keys), `plan` (the plan and its limits — everything is free during the beta), `keys` (list keys by prefix), `revoke_key` (with `key_prefix`), `delete` (a confirmation link the user must open).
action.title: Action

key_prefix.description: With action=`revoke_key`: the key prefix from action=`keys`.
key_prefix.title: Key Prefix

session.description: The `session` value the sign-in returned. Pass it on every call in this conversation, so the sign-in survives however this client handles connections; omit it when the user connected with Sign in (OAuth) or a key.

tier.description: Not needed during the beta: everything is free and there is no paid plan to choose.
tier.title: Tier
